description: Launch the game as its own process, connected straight back to GodotLens - no editor run slot, so several agents can each run one at once. Returns: session_id, and the output and structured errors from the first seconds. Runs HEADLESS by default (no window, no sound); pass windowed=true only when you need runtime_screenshot - the window is placed off-screen and takes no focus. Script errors are reported, never stop the game. Then use runtime_tree, runtime_inspect and runtime_output to see what the game is doing. The game runs through GodotLens's helper (loaded for this run only, nothing is written to the project), which adds runtime_eval and runtime_input.

collect.description: Seconds of output to wait for (default 2)

helper.description: Run through the helper for runtime_eval/runtime_input (default true)

resolution.description: Window size for windowed runs, e.g. '1280x720'

scene.description: res:// scene to run (default: the main scene)

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the game to connect (default 30)

windowed.description: Render a real window (needed for screenshots)

name: runtime_run
